acquisition method: top 15 precursor ion selection and dynamic exclusion of 27 s
alkylation reagent: treated with UC buffer with 50 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature for 20 min
alkylation concentration: treated with UC buffer with 50 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature for 20 min
cleavage agent: Peptides were obtained after overnight incubation with trypsin at 37°C
collision energy: fragmentation was performed in higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) mode with a normalised collision energy of 28
enrichment method: 77.8 µl of 50% streptavidin/agarose slurry was added per mg of whole-cell lysate and incubated for 90 min at 4°C
fragmentation method: fragmentation was performed in higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) mode
instrument: coupled with tandem mass spectrometry (Q Exactive, Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: we used stable isotope labelling with amino acids in cell culture (SILAC) and quantitative proteomic analysis to compare WT and ΔEMC cells
reduction reagent: Disulfide bonds were reduced by incubation with PBS/0.5% (w/v) SDS and 100 mM DTT at room temperature for 20 min
reduction concentration: Disulfide bonds were reduced by incubation with PBS/0.5% (w/v) SDS and 100 mM DTT at room temperature for 20 min
